fact: The head of the Egyptian Healthcare Authority said phase two of universal health insurance, covering 744 facilities including 674 family health centres and units in five governorates, will rely on electronic medical files and electronic linkage between facilities.
title: الرعاية الصحية: 744 منشأة طبية بالمرحلة الثانية لمنظومة التأمين الصحي الشامل
